build: mkdir -p build && cc -O2 -fPIC -DTERMINFO_DIRS='"/usr/share/terminfo:/usr/lib/terminfo:/usr/local/share/terminfo:/usr/local/lib/terminfo:/etc/terminfo:/lib/terminfo"' -c unibilium.c uniutil.c uninames.c && cc -dynamiclib -o libunibilium.2.dylib unibilium.o uniutil.o uninames.o -install_name #{self.install}/lib/libunibilium.2.dylib && ln -sf libunibilium.2.dylib libunibilium.dylib && sed -e 's#@prefix@##{self.install}#' -e 's#@libdir@#lib#' -e 's#@includedir@#include#' -e 's#@VERSION@#2.1.2#' unibilium.pc.in > unibilium.pc
install: mkdir -p #{self.install}/lib #{self.install}/include #{self.install}/lib/pkgconfig && install -m 644 unibilium.h #{self.install}/include/ && install -m 755 libunibilium.2.dylib #{self.install}/lib/ && ln -sf libunibilium.2.dylib #{self.install}/lib/libunibilium.dylib && install -m 644 unibilium.pc #{self.install}/lib/pkgconfig/unibilium.pc
